name: Kotost Aura Assets
summary: Grey and red screen filters for the native mod Kotost Aura.
description:
The grey (**MOGGED**) and red (close-up) screen filters for the native mod **Kotost Aura** (`kotost_aura`), made as vanilla post chains, not a shader pack.

This pack has only the filters; the edits, camera, captions and aura are Kotost Aura's. Install both. No Minecraft code or assets are included.
